passages.text: Reality TV star Dog the Bounty Hunter teams up with Billings bounty hunter, bondsman. Dog the Bounty Hunter, his wife, Beth, and the bounty crew stop in Billings to film an episode for their new show, “Dog and Beth On the Hunt,” airing on CMT.

Ends Show to Save Bail. Industry (EXCLUSIVE) Duane “Dog the Bounty Hunter” Chapman and his wife Beth are ending their hit show Dog and Beth: On the Hunt in an attempt to save the bail industry, which is under attack nationwide. Beth has now announced her candidacy for the presidency of the Professional Bail Agents of the United States (PBUS).

Mini Bio (1) Beth Chapman was born on October 29, 1967 in Denver, Colorado, USA as Alice Elizabeth Smith. She is a producer, known for Dog the Bounty Hunter (2003), Dog and Beth: On the Hunt (2013) and Dog: The Family Speaks (2006). She has been married to Duane 'Dog' Chapman since May 20, 2006.

Television personality Dog the Bounty Hunter and his wife Beth are being sued for $30 million by a fellow fugitive seeker who claims his life was ruined by appeared on their show. Charles Fisher claims his reputation and bounty hunting business were destroyed after he was featured on the On The Hunt episode of Dog And Beth: On The Hunt.

However, despite the seemingly heartfelt reunion, the family may still be split. Dog's wife Beth Tweeted a message to Duane Lee -- what's going on over there son you ok -- while the show aired but he didn't respond. The family drama continues on Dog The Bounty Hunter, Wednesdays at 9:30 p.m. ET on A&E.
